title: Input-Length Oracle on Encoded Indices
statement: For every finite Boolean string $x$ and natural number $k\le |x|$, the first oracle associated with the nondeterministic machine $N$, queried on the pair encoding of $x$ and the binary representation of $k$, returns true exactly when $k<|x|$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
